description: Add Garmin Connect API integration for uploading completed rides with automatic background sync

phases.name: Garmin Connect API Client Implementation
phases.description: Implement the full Garmin Connect API client with OAuth authentication, FIT file upload, and profile retrieval

subtasks.title: Implement Garmin OAuth configuration and constants
subtasks.description: Add Garmin Connect OAuth endpoints, client credentials handling, and token structures. Garmin uses OAuth 2.0 for authorization.
subtasks.notes: Added Garmin OAuth structures (GarminTokenResponse, GarminOAuthErrorResponse), token exchange and refresh methods, GARMIN_TOKEN_URL constant, and OAuth scopes module with default_scopes function. Implementation follows Strava/TrainingPeaks patterns.

subtasks.title: Implement GarminClient HTTP client setup
subtasks.description: Complete the GarminClient struct with HTTP client, access token storage, and base URL configuration following the Strava pattern
subtasks.notes: Added HTTP client (reqwest::Client), timeout constants (DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS=60, UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECS=120), GARMIN_API_BASE_URL constant, with_base_url() test constructor, accessor methods (base_url(), http_client(), upload_timeout(), default_timeout()), and get_access_token() helper. Updated all API methods to use the new helper. Added comprehensive tests. Follows StravaClient pattern exactly.

subtasks.title: Implement Garmin FIT file upload endpoint
subtasks.description: Implement upload_activity method for uploading FIT files to Garmin Connect using multipart form data. Handle response parsing and error cases.
subtasks.notes: Implemented upload_activity method with multipart form data upload. Added: GarminUploadResponse/DetailedImportResult/GarminUploadSuccess/GarminUploadFailure structs for response parsing, GarminApiError with Display impl, validate_fit_file() for FIT validation, is_duplicate_error() for duplicate detection. Full error handling for rate limiting (429), unauthorized (401), forbidden (403), conflict/duplicate (409), and generic errors. Comprehensive unit tests and HTTP mocked tests with wiremock. Follows Strava pattern exactly.

subtasks.title: Implement Garmin user profile retrieval
subtasks.description: Implement get_user_profile method to fetch the authenticated user's Garmin Connect profile for display in settings
subtasks.notes: Implemented get_user_profile method with HTTP call to /userprofile-service/socialProfile endpoint. Added GarminSocialProfileResponse struct for API response parsing with fields: user_id, display_name, full_name, and profile image URLs (small/medium/large). Updated GarminUserProfile struct to include full_name field and readable_name() method. Full error handling for rate limiting (429), unauthorized (401), forbidden (403), and generic API errors. Comprehensive unit tests and HTTP mocked tests with wiremock. Follows StravaClient get_athlete pattern exactly.

subtasks.title: Implement Garmin deauthorization/logout
subtasks.description: Implement logout method to revoke OAuth tokens and clear local credentials
subtasks.notes: Implemented deauthorize() method following the Strava pattern. Added oauth_base_url configuration to GarminClient, GARMIN_OAUTH_BASE_URL constant, and comprehensive error handling that always clears the local token regardless of API response. Updated with_base_url() to accept both API and OAuth URLs. Added unit tests for deauthorize without token and comprehensive HTTP mocked tests using wiremock for all scenarios (success, rate limit, unauthorized, not found, server error, API error with body).

subtasks.title: Add Garmin API error handling
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling for Garmin API responses including rate limiting, token expiry, duplicate detection, and network errors
subtasks.notes: Implemented comprehensive error handling utilities for Garmin API responses: Added ErrorCategory enum for classifying errors (Transient, RateLimited, Authentication, Client, Server, Permanent) with retry logic helpers. Added RateLimitInfo struct for parsing Retry-After headers and rate limit information. Added SyncErrorExt trait providing is_retryable(), requires_auth_refresh(), is_rate_limited(), is_duplicate(), and retry_delay_secs() methods. Added helper methods on GarminClient: handle_error_status() for consistent HTTP status mapping, map_request_error() for network error categorization, and parse_error_response() for API error parsing. Added comprehensive tests for all new functionality.

phases.name: OAuth Flow Integration
phases.description: Integrate Garmin OAuth flow with the existing OAuth infrastructure

subtasks.title: Add Garmin OAuth provider configuration
subtasks.description: Register Garmin Connect as an OAuth provider in the oauth.rs module with correct endpoints and scopes
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive OAuth tests for Garmin Connect in oauth.rs following the exact pattern of Strava and TrainingPeaks. Tests include: HTTP mocked tests for token exchange (success, invalid code, invalid client, server error, invalid JSON), HTTP mocked tests for token refresh (success, invalid_grant, invalid_token, generic error, server error), authorization URL building test verifying Garmin-specific format (no scope in auth URL), response parsing tests for GarminTokenResponse (with/without optional scope field), error response parsing tests (invalid_grant, invalid_client, invalid_request, unauthorized), and test for missing client secret handling. The Garmin OAuth provider was already registered in Phase 1 with token exchange/refresh methods and token URL - this subtask completes the test coverage.

subtasks.title: Implement Garmin token exchange flow
subtasks.description: Implement the OAuth callback handler to exchange authorization code for access/refresh tokens
subtasks.notes: OAuth callback handler for Garmin token exchange is fully implemented. The exchange_garmin_token method (oauth.rs:603-673) handles authorization code exchange with Garmin's token endpoint, including form-encoded POST request, GarminTokenResponse parsing with expires_in to DateTime conversion, and comprehensive error handling via GarminOAuthErrorResponse. The handle_callback method correctly routes GarminConnect to this exchange method with state validation for CSRF protection. Comprehensive test coverage includes: token exchange success, optional scope handling, invalid_grant/invalid_client errors, server errors, and invalid JSON responses. Implementation was completed as part of Phase 1 (1.1) and Phase 2.1, verified complete.
